correctness.rationale: For every strictly positive least-period-two orbit, positivity of prey x forces 0<x_i<1. Adding the normalized prey and predator update equations yields S_x<2(a−1)/a and S_y<2(b+d−1)/b. Arithmetic-harmonic inequalities imply R_x>a when a≤3 and R_y>b when b+d≤3, including weak endpoints because c,d>0. Subtracting yields (R_x−a)Δx=cΔy and (R_y−b)Δy=−dΔx, whose strictly positive determinant (R_x−a)(R_y−b)+cd forces Δx=Δy=0. At a or b just above 3, scalar f_r(u)=ru(1−u) has hyperbolic attracting primitive two-cycle for 3<r<1+sqrt(6), which continues by IFT to small c=d>0 while the other coordinate stays logistic fixed at 1/2. Inspected actual checker.py confirms normalized identities symbolically; external independent SymPy symbolic subtraction reproduced them. The theorem does not require global positive-quadrant invariance.
